pricing.faq.title: Questions
pricing.faq.q1: How do I get my books after I pay?
pricing.faq.a1: Create an account here with the same email you paid with on Gumroad. Your membership and books appear in My library automatically.
pricing.faq.a2: You keep member access until the end of the period you paid for. Books you bought individually are yours to keep.
pricing.faq.q3: Can I buy just one book?
pricing.faq.a3: Yes. Every book can be bought on its own from its page.
pricing.faq.a4: Payments go through Gumroad, which accepts cards and PayPal in most countries.

blog.calc.line: See what a higher price does to the clients you serve.
calc.title: What are your services worth?
calc.subtitle: A pre-tax estimate for stylists. See one week of the clients you serve, then unlock the year.
calc.priceHint: US dollars. One average price for the services you offer.
calc.optionalShow: Add tips, booth rent, or commission
calc.optionalHide: Hide tips, booth rent, and commission
calc.optionalHint: Optional. Closed, this estimates services only.
calc.tipsHint: Tips stay with you. They are not split with the shop.
calc.pay.commissionHint: You keep a percent of each service
calc.rentHint: Counted for all 52 weeks, including weeks you take off.
calc.weeklyCaption: Clients you serve × price per service × days. Pre-tax.
calc.weeklyAdjusted: This week includes the tips and shop terms you set. Pre-tax.
calc.weeklyLocked: The weekly number is hidden until you join the newsletter.
calc.mathCaption: Clients you serve × price per service × days × weeks.
calc.mathCaptionAdjusted: That is the service math. Tips and shop terms change the take-home.
calc.yearlyHidden: The yearly total, the full breakdown, and a $5 price raise stay locked until you join the newsletter.
calc.gate.micro: Get your full breakdown and GSWAU's weekly tip. Unsubscribe any time.
calc.leverBody: Same clients you serve. A $5 higher price per service.

calc.unlockedLive: Change the numbers and this updates.
calc.confirmInbox: Check your inbox to confirm your subscription. Your estimate is below either way.

calc.cta.label: Learn how to raise your prices

calc.assume.tips: Tips stay with you in every pay model. They are not commission-split.

calc.assume.price: One average price stands in for your mix of services.
